In today’s show, we will discuss:
1. Why your body need Iodine: How much iodine do you need every day? What are the early signs of iodine deficiency? Can you still develop an iodine deficiency despite consuming iodized salt regularly? Does eating more salt fulfil your iodine requirements, or can excessive salt intake harm your health? What are the other dietary sources of iodine besides salt? Guest: Dr. Rashmi Rasi Datta, Consultant Biochemist & Section Head, Agilus Diagnostics.
